dual.icon: Two identical weapons, one in each hand

gear.askShield: A hand is free: also create the shield?

suffocation.hint: Out of air: unconscious and suffocating. At the end of each turn: a Fortitude saving throw against DC 20, +5 for each earlier check. Failure: 1d10 damage per check made; critical failure: death.
suffocation.start: {name} has run out of air: falls unconscious and starts suffocating. At the end of each turn: a Fortitude saving throw against DC {dc} (+5 for each further check).
suffocation.startHidden: {name} has run out of air: falls unconscious and starts suffocating. At the end of each turn: a Fortitude saving throw (the DC grows with each check).
suffocation.dead: {name} dies of suffocation (critical failure on the Fortitude save). The module does not apply death: that is up to the GM.

follow.hint: {name}: the Strike "{strike}" hit "{target}". The creature can spend an action on it: {act}.

hunt.needTarget: "{name}": target exactly one creature before using Hunt Prey.
hunt.needTargets: "{name}": target one or two creatures before using Hunt Prey.

builtin.needOneTarget: "{name}": exactly one target is required (target it before using).

blood.title: Blood Magic
blood.prompt: {name} cast a blood spell (aberrant bloodline). Choose:
blood.self: Self: +2 status bonus to Will saves for 1 round
blood.target: Target "{name}": -1 status penalty to Will saves for 1 round

double.title: Double Slice
double.map: Current multiple attack penalty (for both Strikes)
double.noWeapons: "{name}": needs two melee weapons, one in each hand (equipped, held in one hand).
double.sameWeapon: "{name}": the same weapon was chosen twice.
double.mergeFailed: Double Slice: could not combine damage; two separate rolls are shown - add them manually (precision damage once).
double.next: {name}: counts as two attacks. The next Strike this turn takes the third-attack penalty: {map}.

fakeOut.title: Fake Out
fakeOut.hurt: +1: dealt damage to this enemy with this weapon since your last turn began

spellshape.hint: {shape}: the next spell {name} casts gets this spellshape. The effect is spent by the cast and ends with the next cast or at the end of the turn.

rage.raging: {name} is already raging and can't Rage again (requirement: not raging).
rage.fatigued: {name} is fatigued and can't Rage (requirement: not fatigued). The effect wasn't applied; the GM can apply it from the card button.
rage.quick: Quick-Tempered: {name} rolled initiative and can Rage as a free action.
rage.concentrate: {name} is raging: “{what}” has the concentrate trait without rage — not allowed while raging (Seek is).

flight.hint: The fly Speed applies to this movement: the effect ends after the first movement or at the end of the turn.
flight.fall: Falling: if you aren't on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall.

oneShot.hint: One Shot, One Kill: {name} rolled Stealth for initiative. Interact to draw a firearm or crossbow; the first Strike with it deals extra precision damage.

tentacles.hint: Unarmed Strike reach is 10 feet. Extending to 20 feet with an extra action when casting is manual.

surprise.effect: Surprise Attack: creatures yet to act
surprise.hint: Surprise Attack: {name} rolled Deception or Stealth for initiative. In the first round, creatures that have not acted yet are off-guard to them until their turn starts.

builtin.prolongAll: {name}: the effect carries several negative conditions ({names}) — all will be prolonged (the text says one condition of your choice). Prolong by hand if you need just one.

limit.noAura: {name}: your kinetic aura isn't active — {channel} first. Alt-click to use anyway.
limit.noHand: {name}: no hand free to shape the elemental flow (impulses need a free hand). Free a hand. Alt-click to use anyway.
limit.overflow: {name}: you already used an overflow impulse this round (one per round). Alt-click to use anyway.
limit.auraActive: {name}: your kinetic aura is already active (requires your kinetic gate to be inactive). Dismiss it first. Alt-click to use anyway.
limit.torches: {name}: the maximum number of torches is already active (Constitution modifier, {n}). Dismiss one. Alt-click to use anyway.
limit.hex: {name}: you already used a hex this turn (one per turn, a second attempt fails). Alt-click to use anyway.
limit.reaction: {name}: your reaction is already spent this round. Alt-click to use anyway.
limit.recharge: {name}: recharging — {n} more (until round {until}). Alt-click to use anyway.
limit.rcOutOfCombat: Recharge is counted in combat only
limit.rcNotLast: The button works only on the latest use card in the current combat
limit.rcFailed: Could not save the recharge: no lock was set
limit.req: {name}: requirement not met — {need}. Alt-click to use anyway.
limit.needStrike: your last action must be a successful Strike
limit.needStrikeFx: your last action must be a successful Strike that lists {fx}
limit.needStrikeSpecial: your last action must be a successful Strike with a special effect
limit.needHolds: you have a creature Grabbed or Restrained
limit.frequency: {name}: no uses left (frequency exhausted). Reset it by hand on the sheet or wait for it to recharge. Alt-click to use anyway.

builtin.automationsConflict: PF2e AuTOMATO is incompatible with pf2e-automations: everything it automates is already in AuTOMATO, and together they process items twice (double damage and effects). Disable pf2e-automations in Manage Modules.
builtin.wrapFailed: pf2e-automato: the «{what}» check is not installed (conflict with another module: {error}). The restriction is off.
builtin.computedNoNeutralize: pf2e-automato: the toggle of a computed option (Pack Attack) is not hidden — the option is not added to damage. Likely cause: a conflict with another module or the pf2e version. The «Computed roll options» mode can be turned off.
builtin.inertAction: This action only describes the ability — attack and roll damage with its strike buttons below.

reach.out: {name} is out of reach: {d} ft, reach {r} ft. Alt-click to strike anyway.

ward.hint: {guard}: cover {ally} with your shield? Shield Block, Hardness {hardness}.
ward.needTarget: {name}: target an ally before using this.
ward.guardianText: {name} shields you: a circumstance bonus to AC while the shield is raised.

link.lifeLink: Life Link with {name}: the first damage each round is reduced, the caster loses HP.
link.shareLife: Share Life with {name}: the target takes half damage, the caster takes the rest.
link.spiritLink: {spell}, caster {name}: at the start of their turn the target regains HP and the caster loses as many (regeneration and fast healing of the caster are off: the GM tracks it).
link.spiritEnd: {spell}: {caster} is at 0 HP, the link with {target} has ended. Apply the caster's condition (unconscious, dying) by hand: the transfer writes HP directly.

maneuver.needTarget: {name}: choose exactly one target (target it on the canvas).
maneuver.far: {name} is {d} ft away: out of range ({r} ft). Alt skips the check.

channeling.title: Channeling Block
channeling.done: {name}: expended {spell} (rank {rank}), shield Hardness +{bonus} for this block.

apparition.none: {name} feels no spirits, haunts or undead nearby.

share.title: Shared prey
share.prompt: {name}: who gets the prey and the hunter's edge?
share.needPrey: {name}: no prey yet, use Hunt Prey first.

shieldBlock.gone: Damage message or target is gone.
shieldBlock.lowered: The shield is no longer raised: no block, reaction not spent.
shieldBlock.applied: Damage from this message was already applied to this target.

damaged.hint: {actor}: {target} is about to take damage. Use «{item}»?
damaged.waiting: Damage is waiting for a reaction decision.
damaged.gone: Damage message, target or ability is gone.
damaged.applied: Damage from this message was already applied to this target.
damaged.notUsed: The ability was not used (no spell slot or focus?): reaction not spent, damage goes through.
damaged.expired: The moment to react has passed (the damage was dealt or the turn ended).

failed.gone: The check message, the actor or the ability is gone.
failed.expired: The moment to reroll has passed (the check was accepted or the turn ended).
failed.notRerolled: The reroll did not happen (no connection to the roller?): nothing was spent, the result stands.
failed.noResource: The ability has no uses left: cannot reroll.

basicDamage.locked: Damage was already applied by the module; to undo, use the ↺ button on the damage-taken message. GM: Alt to bypass.
basicDamage.lockedNoUndo: Damage to this target was already handled by the module (×0, nothing to undo). GM: Alt to bypass.
basicDamage.noUndo: Recalculation for {name} skipped: the earlier damage could not be reverted (damage message not found). Fix the target's hit points by hand.
basicDamage.changed: Save result for {name} changed after damage was applied ({item}). Use "Recalculate" on the damage card.

reactive.hint: Reactive Strike: {source} uses a {trigger} within {holder}'s reach. Reaction: @UUID[{item}]
reactive.cannot: No permission for this actor, or the target is gone.
reactive.moveStep: a 5-foot shift (if it was a Step, no reaction)

onyx.title: Onyx Dog
onyx.prompt: Activate {name}'s figurine: summon a Guard Dog nearby (up to 6 hours)?
onyx.cooldown: Less than a week since the last activation (days left: {days}).
onyx.noToken: Onyx Dog: the owner has no token on the scene.
onyx.noSpot: no free space next to the owner
onyx.summoned: {name}: summoned {dog}. It reverts in 6 hours of game time.

strike.map: Current multiple attack penalty (for the first Strike)
strike.mapHint: The system doesn't count attacks — pick the penalty your next Strike would have.

cast.prompt: "{name}": how many actions did you spend casting?
cast.split: Missiles: {total}. Split them among the targets (the sum must be {total}).
cast.splitBad: The missile counts must add up to {total}.
cast.noLiveTargets: Every target was dropped (out of range or failed flat check) — no one to send the missiles at.
